reason: A DSH interface plugin providing draggable, resizable floating windows for live project previews and workspace code browsing and editing.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 提供可拖拽、可调整大小的项目预览窗口和工作区代码查看与编辑窗口。
summaries.en: Adds draggable, resizable floating windows to DSH for live project previews and workspace code browsing and editing.

capabilities: Embeds a project development server in an iframe for live preview
Lists and reads workspace files for code viewing
Edits and writes workspace files after user confirmation
Records code-edit session events in DSH logs
